name: Atlanta–Fulton County Stadium
scope: Whole circular multipurpose stadium as representative June1974 historical reconstruction: complete asymmetric open baseball field, stepped lower/intermediate/upper seating bowls, white radial bent/raker concrete skeleton, genuinely open exterior concourses and upper stand underside, inset service/gallery ring, portals/aisles, press/scoreboard volumes and restrained rim light banks. Exclude demolished-site parking, current replacement ballpark/Turner Field, cars/vegetation/players/logos/advertisements.
era: Representative June1974 exterior/EPA photograph, with generic baseball configuration informed by native preserved painted field and1983 own-photo fence. Not a claim of exact game-day equipment or later1996 fitout. Stadium demolished August1997; historical-only opt-in month.

references.caption: I took this photo of Nolan Ryan of the Houston Astros at Atlanta-Fulton County Stadium on June 28, 1983. In the background is left-fielder Jose Cruz, who Ryan once said was his favorite teammate. The Astros won the game 4-3. Ryan pitched for 8 innings and gave up only 2 hits, both of them homers.
